title: Single-Actuator Lab Score
description:
The judgement of one capture, SPLIT IN TWO and kept apart by the schema itself.

`measured` holds what the harness can compute without a human: availability, leakage, call counts, latency, mask well-formedness, conversion survival, invariants. `review` holds what only a human or a gold mask can settle: whether the mask is of the thing the words named.

The split is structural rather than conventional because the temptation it guards against is specific and strong: a high confidence and a clean RLE make a wrong mask look right. SF-004-R2 measured exactly that — `shoulder fabric` at 0.27–0.43 returned a well-formed mask OF THE BACKGROUND. Nothing in `measured` can therefore write `review.concept_binding`, and `verdict.semantic_correctness` stays `not_established` until a reviewer or a gold mask says otherwise.

availability.description: Why it could not run, when it could not. `weights_absent` and `runtime_absent` are separated because they are fixed by different actions.

planner_valid.description: Null when no planner ran. False when the planner named an unknown/unlocked actuator or proposed more calls than the budget.

actuator_leakage.description: Did anything other than the lock reach an instrument? Must be false for a usable run.

planner_requested_unlocked.description: What the planner ASKED for and was refused. Recorded rather than filtered — how often the mind reaches past its hands is the observable.

max_pairwise_iou.description: Highest overlap between two returned instances. High values mean the organ returned near-duplicates, which inflates an instance count that a reader would otherwise take for coverage.

conversion_survival.description: Modes B/C. Instances in, regions and descriptors out, and anything the wrapper or the epistemic guard dropped.

two_status_preserved.description: Modes B/C. True when the wrapper emitted the measured extent and the interpretive naming as SEPARATE claims — the whole point of the concept_segment contract.

violations.description: Named, not counted. A violation is a fact about this run and belongs in the report as text.

review.description: Every judgement here is null until a human or a gold mask supplies it. Null means UNKNOWN and must render as unknown; it never renders as pass.

concept_binding.description: Did the mask land on what the words named? The single question confidence cannot answer.

empty_means.description: The question a negative control exists to ask. Undetermined is a real and common answer.

harness.description: Did the lab itself behave — one call, locked actuator, nothing written, image untouched.

semantic_correctness.description: NEVER derived from confidence, instance count, or a well-formed RLE. `not_established` is the honest default and the only value the harness may write by itself.

attribution.description: The one sentence this lab exists to be able to say: WHICH LAYER produced this outcome.

pair.description: Filled by `compare`: the paired control this run is read against.
